questions.q: In a certain code language, ‘all the best’ is written as ‘sen mil kyu', ‘we are best’ is written as 'din zec mil', and 'are they mad' is written as 'sip zec lir'. How will 'we' be written in that language?
o: zec
din
mil
lir

The correct answer is: b

To decode "we" in the given code language:

  • 'we are best' → 'din zec mil'
  • 'are they mad' → 'sip zec lir'

The common word in both sentences is 'are', and the common code is 'zec'. So, 'are' = 'zec'. Similarly,

  • All the best' → 'sen mil kyu'
  • 'we are best→ 'din zec mil'

The common word in both sentences is 'best', and the common code is 'mil'. So, 'best' = 'mil'.

So, in “we are best”, are= zec, best=mil. So, We=din

20. In a certain code language, "HELP" is written as "1652432" and "SAVE" is written as "381445". How will "MAIL" be written in that language?

SSC CHSL 26/05/2022 (Evening)
questions.s:
20.(b)

questions_hin.q_hi: 12. एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में, "CROW" को "6970" और "ORCA" को "7569" के रूप में कूटबद्ध किया जाता है। दी गई कूट भाषा में "W" का कूट क्या है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
12.(d) दिया गया :- C R O W → 6 9 7 0 ……… (i)

O R C A → 7 5 6 9 ….. (ii)

I और II से C, R, O और 697

अतः "W" का कोड = 0

questions_hin.q_hi: 11. यदि CHARGER को 129 के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है तो HINGES को किस प्रकार कोडित किया जाएगा ?
2. एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में, "mobile switched off’ को ‘rq mg cr" लिखा जाता है और "turn off light" को "my cp rq" लिखा जाता है। उसी कूट भाषा में "off" को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions_hin.s_hi:
2.(c) mobile switched off → rq mg cr……(i)
turn off light → my cp rq………(ii)
(i) और (ii) से "off" और "rq" उभयनिष्ठ हैं। "off" का कोड = "rq"।
